summary: Linkage Global Inc filed a Form 6-K reporting a Securities Purchase Agreement for a private placement of up to 5,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.12 per share, totaling up to US$600,000. The offering closed on June 12, 2026, with proceeds for general corporate purposes. Shares were issued under Regulation S to non-U.S. persons, with a commitment to file a registration statement within 30 business days. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No strategic event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private transaction is involved.
